title: A read-only Kimi child's gate refuses the tracker's reads that a read-only Claude child is now allowed
outcome: A read-only Kimi child that is not an evaluator may make the same tracker reads that record nothing as a read-only Claude child (the one list in src/engram_mcp_config.rs), under Kimi's own gate rules: the complete streamed arguments observed, the summary matching the tool, approve once. Every other tracker call stays refused.
acceptance: Every tracker word that writes, `next` without a peek, a context generation and an unknown argument are refused for a read-only Kimi child; a test lists each.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.

kimi_read_only_permission_decision allows `mcp__engram__<read word>` calls judged by the shared list, only when the host admits tracker reads for the session and the observed arguments and summary match; a test covers allow and each refusal.

completion.summary: Delivered Kimi shared nonrecording tracker-read admission with exact observed argument/title/summary and approve-once/Stop/runtime fences preserved. Nine registered Central tests passed; clean independent pair and exact-input full gate passed; contribution landed/pushed unchanged and binary installed. Running host restart/live Kimi execution not claimed or required by these implementation criteria.
